title: Width-Adjusted Machine State
statement: Given a phase $q$, a state $S$, and a natural number $r$, define a new state by replacing its code width $w$ with $K_0(r+S.Lg+1)$, its code bound $K$ with $2^{K_0(r+S.Lg+1)}$, and its memory base $Bs$ with $2^{K_0(r+S.Lg+1)}$ when $q$ is the second-search phase and twice that value otherwise. All other components remain those of $S$.
